title: 天皇賞（春）の後に・『悔しい』

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mihono Bourbon fails to conquer her rivals and loses the spring Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She feels frustrated for the first time and is at a loss for how to deal with the emotion.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: To dispel her burning, white-hot frustration, she seeks to win a race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As a result, we decide to enter the Japan Cup, where the powerful Tokai Teio will surely be racing.
